name: OpenHealthOSIG
title: OpenHealth OS FHIR R4 Implementation Guide (Nigeria)
description: Nigerian FHIR R4 profiles for the OpenHealth OS platform: Patient, Encounter, Claim, Coverage, Consent. ABDM-pattern registry+gateway alignment, OpenHIE-compatible. Adds executable quality measures (Measure/MeasureReport) so care standards are uniform across locations, and the emergency (EMER) Encounter usage that ADR-0019 dispatch rides on.
